title: Find the Longest Word in a Sentence
statement: Given a sentence, return the longest word in it. Assume words are separated by spaces. If multiple words have the same length, return the first one.
think: What is the task asking? Find the word with the maximum length.
What is the key operation? Compare each word length with the best seen so far.
What wording signals stand out? Longest, word, sentence.
What is the brute force idea? Compare each word with every other word.
What is the better/optimal idea? Split into words and track the longest in one pass.
What are the edge cases? One word, ties, extra spaces.
What is the complexity? O(n) total character processing.
How would I explain it in an interview? I scan words once and keep the current longest candidate.
algorithm: Split sentence into words removing empty entries
interview: I would split the sentence into words and track the longest word seen so far in one pass.
ru: Нужно просто пройти по словам и держать текущее самое длинное. Это обычный linear scan по словам.
visualExplanation:
sentence = "I love automation testing"
I -> best = I
love -> best = love
automation -> best = automation
testing -> keep automation

important: Overwrite on equal length when first should win

gaps: Important: scan words and keep current best
Nice to have: mention tie handling explicitly
edgeCases: two longest words with same length
constraints: Assume words are separated by spaces.
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan because we compare each word once against the current best candidate.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Sorting, because sorting is unnecessary work for just one best answer.
Not Dictionary, because no frequency map is required.
